title: Moodboard Library
notes:
- LIBRARY button in the Refs rail: Figma-style moodboards per project — pan/zoom canvas, multiple boards, upload, pick from your renders
- Built-in Pinterest browser: log in once, right-click any pin or drag it onto your board — full-resolution originals download automatically
- Send any board image to Input, Refs, or the Gemini chat
- Locked-seed history: every seed you lock is kept with a thumbnail — jump back anytime
- Audio, notification and update popups now always render above the UI in every mode
- Continue cards on the home open their project directly
